posts.author: Jrrkein
posts.body: If someone owns the full version, how would they reduce the gold for the pull? Asking for a friend

posts.author: Undermax
posts.body:
All the information is inside the documentation and in the video attached. Please read it.
Available Commands:
variable(ID, +/-Value): Adjusts the value of a variable.
Example: "variable(3, -5)"
Use case: Deduct currency for a gacha draw.
switch(ID, on/off): Sets a switch on or off.
Example: "switch(5, on)"
money(+/-Amount): Adds or removes player gold.
Example: "money(-300)"
Use case: remove gold when play the gacha.
common_event(ID): Triggers a common event.
Example: "common_event(4)"
